meta_patterns.description: Persistent homology, spin-glass order parameters, holographic complexity, and assembly index all converge on a single principle: the most complex structures are those that survive coarse-graining.
Quiescent halos, spin glasses at T_c, black holes at Page time, and conscious systems at Φ_threshold all represent phase transitions where information structure qualitatively changes.
